# Kalappura Houseboats & Tours

> Private luxury houseboats in Alleppey (Alappuzha), Kerala, India.

## About
Kalappura Houseboats & Tours operates private houseboat stays on the backwaters of Alleppey (Alappuzha), Kerala. We offer 1, 2, and 3 bedroom traditional kettuvallam houseboats with modern amenities including air conditioning, private bathrooms, and onboard chef-prepared Kerala cuisine.

## Quick Facts
- Location: Alleppey (Alappuzha), Kerala, India
- Phone: +91 98950 53528
- Website: https://alleppeyhouseboat.online
- Boat Types: 1 Bedroom (up to 3 guests), 2 Bedroom (up to 6 guests), 3 Bedroom (up to 9 guests)
- All boats are private (not shared with other groups)
- All boats have AC, private bathrooms, and onboard kitchen
- Check-in: 12:00 PM, Check-out: 9:00 AM (overnight stay)

## Pricing
- Standard Package: ₹15,000 per room per night
- Premium Package: ₹19,000 per room per night
- Semi Luxury Package: ₹24,000 per room per night
- 18% GST applicable
- Children under 5: Free
- Children 6-11: ₹1,000/night extra
- Extra bed: ₹1,000/night

## What's Included in Every Booking
- Overnight backwater cruise (12 PM to 9 AM next day)
- All meals: lunch, evening tea & snacks, dinner, breakfast
- Air-conditioned bedrooms
- Private bathrooms with hot water
- Onboard crew: captain, chef, helper
- Cruise through Vembanad Lake and village canals
- Free parking at dock
- Free cancellation up to 7 days before check-in

## Packages
### Standard Package (₹15,000/room/night)
- AC: 8:30 PM to 6:30 AM (bedroom only)
- 1 non-veg item per meal
- 5-stop cruise route
- Welcome drink: Lime juice

### Premium Package (₹19,000/room/night)
- AC: 5:30 PM to 7:30 AM (bedroom/hall)
- 2 non-veg items per meal (seafood + chicken)
- 7-stop cruise route
- Welcome drink: Tender coconut

### Semi Luxury Package (₹24,000/room/night)
- AC: Available all the time
- 2 non-veg items per meal (premium seafood + chicken)
- 7-stop cruise route
- Welcome drink: Tender coconut

## Schedule (Same for all packages)
- 12:00 PM: Check-in & welcome drinks
- 1:00 PM: Lunch
- 1:30-5:00 PM: Backwater cruise
- 5:00 PM: Evening anchoring, tea & snacks
- 7:30-8:30 PM: Dinner
- 9:00 AM next day: Breakfast & check-out

## Cruise Route
Kainakari Village, Kuppappuram Village, Vembanad Lake, Punnamada Lake, Meenappally Lake, Meenappally Village, Pallathuruthi
